about_the_product.description: The Amerimax Vinyl Hidden Hanger has a durable vinyl construction and a brown baked-on finish to match most home exteriors. The hook installs easily and is designed to mount directly to the fascia for gutter hanging systems. This hook is designed to withstand extreme temperatures from -40 to 150 degrees Fahrenheit and has UV stabilizers for additional durability. This hook is easy to install and mounts directly to the fascia. For best results, use hooks every 18-24 inches along gutter lengths. The product measures 4.5 in. H x 2.75 in. W x 15.75 in. D. Also known as straps or clips.

user_reviews.text: The whole Vinyl K-Style gutter system works pretty well. I would not want to do a whole house, but for a small cabin or shed it works great as a one person job. The hanger system works well with the recommended screws, just be aware that the screws are angled downward, so when you start to tighten up the hanger/gutter will suck downward, potentially out of how you want it to be leveled. Just hold the cutter system firmly upward to set the screw to keep the gutter where you want it. I also have many maple trees, so also used the foam cutter inserts to keep debris out of the gutters. By the time you buy all the parts and pieces it can get a little spendy, but overall I was happy with the outcome.
